ground_rule: Every Y is computed by tools/apricorn_farm.py from tools/ground.py (the canonical heightmap, rounded); nothing in this file is a Y. All x/z below are LOCAL offsets from site.centre unless a key says otherwise. A grove's terrace floor is, of the levels that leave its gate within one block of the ground outside it (walkable both ways), the one with the least earthwork (then the nearest the plot's median ground); the plot is cut down or filled up to it (a retaining wall on its edge where the outside is lower, a revetment where it is higher); a building's floor is max(ground under its footprint) + 1 on a cobblestone foundation; a path, post, sign or object stands on its own column's ground.

Dry: 0 of 2,401 sampled columns (every 4 blocks over the square) under water (tools/water_mask.py through tools/resident_encounters.py Wet, rivers included). Three sub-regions meet within 30 blocks of the centre (pallet outskirts to the north-west, south_west_fields at the centre, arrow_creeks to the east; data/regions.json): all tier 1. Nearest town footprint: great_oak_pallet 428 blocks, hometown (Pallet) 580. Nearest route corridor box: route_01_pallet_to_brock r01_b0109, 614 blocks; nearest walked route path 666 blocks. The nearest x/z another data file authors that is not a sub-region outline vertex is data/southern_residents.json prospector_camp's piece at (2249, 5639), 194 blocks from the centre. The spot is buildable as given: nothing moved.

No chests (a Gimmighoul condition, tools/portals_audit.py), no beds (the blackout's checkpoints own respawn points), no placed water (minecraft:water is a spawn condition; the troughs and the tower tank are water cauldrons, as data/drovers_hollow.json's spring is). The only spawn-condition blocks written are the seven apricorn fruits: spawn_conditions_allowed.

A town that grows apricorns should get them.'; a second entry scoped to apricorn_farm (the scope rule, tests/test_system_contracts.py C4) was added 2026-10-05 with this farm, decided 'OWNER TO CONFIRM'; the generator refuses to build without it. Read from the 1.8.0 jar: data/cobblemon/spawn_pool_world/0100_voltorb.json (voltorb hisuian, levels 8-33, uncommon) and 0101_electrode.json (electrode hisuian, levels 30-49, uncommon) plus their herds (0101_electrode_alpha is a boss bucket) need #cobblemon:apricorns nearby, sky light 8-15, any overworld biome. The leaves and logs are not spawn conditions.

apricorn_facts.verified_from: experiments/EXP-000-cobblemon-1.8-compat/runtime/server/mods/Cobblemon-fabric-1.8.0+1.21.1.jar (gitignored; read in the main checkout's copy 2026-10-05 with python zipfile and javap)
apricorn_facts.blocks: tree: cobblemon:apricorn_log (axis), cobblemon:apricorn_leaves (vanilla LeavesBlock: CobblemonBlocks.leaves() calls BlocksInvoker.createLeavesBlock, so distance/persistent/waterlogged), saplings cobblemon:<colour>_apricorn_sapling, planted from the item cobblemon:<colour>_apricorn_seed ('<Colour> Apricorn Sprout'). Fruit: cobblemon:<colour>_apricorn for red, blue, yellow, green, pink, white and black, block states age=0..3 and facing=north|south|east|west (assets/cobblemon/blockstates/red_apricorn.json).
apricorn_facts.attachment: ApricornBlock.canSurvive (method_9558): the block at pos.relative(facing) must be in #cobblemon:apricorn_leaves (data/cobblemon/tags/block/apricorn_leaves.json: cobblemon:apricorn_leaves only). So `facing` points AT the leaf the fruit hangs from; remove that leaf and the fruit breaks.
apricorn_facts.regrowth: ApricornBlock.isRandomlyTicking (method_9542) is true while age < 3; randomTick (method_9514): if random.nextInt(5) == 0 and age < 3, age + 1. So a fruit ripens on its own through three stages, one stage per about five random ticks: at the vanilla randomTickSpeed of 3 a block is random-ticked about every 1,365 ticks, so about 5.7 minutes a stage and about 17 minutes from picked to ripe, ONLY while a player keeps its chunk inside simulation distance.
apricorn_facts.harvest: useWithoutItem -> doHarvest -> harvest: Block.dropResources (the loot table) then the same block set back to age 0, with the APRICORN_HARVESTED event. The loot table data/cobblemon/loot_table/blocks/red_apricorn.json drops one cobblemon:red_apricorn only at age 3, and a cobblemon:red_apricorn_seed at age 3 with chance 0.1. So a right-click on a ripe fruit gives one apricorn (one in ten also a sprout) and the fruit regrows on the branch; an unripe one gives nothing.
apricorn_facts.poke_balls: data/cobblemon/recipe/poke_ball.json: four red apricorns round one #cobblemon:tier_1_poke_ball_materials (#c:ingots/copper) make 4 Poke Balls. great_ball: 2 blue + 2 red round tier 2 (#c:ingots/iron), 4. ultra_ball: 2 black + 2 yellow round tier 3 (#c:ingots/gold), 4. 29 ball recipes in all name apricorns (the Ancient balls among them).

decisions_pending.question: The farm gives every player free, renewable apricorns of all seven colours, 600 blocks from Pallet, from the first hour. Red plus a copper ingot makes Poke Balls (the Mart sells them at 200); blue, yellow and black plus iron or gold make Great and Ultra Balls, which data/markets.json keeps behind the Highwire, Tilpey and Pacifidlog counters' badge gates (fenhide_ball_bench's stall_why: 'Iron (tier 2, Great Balls) is left out: the Great Ball is Highwire's gated line'). Keep all seven groves?
decisions_pending.default_taken: all seven, as asked ('groves of all seven colours'). To withhold a colour, delete its grove from `groves` and rebuild: nothing else names a grove. The binding gate on the better balls then becomes iron and gold ingots
decisions_pending.measured: tools/apricorn_farm.py plan, 2026-10-05: 550 fruit (red 101, blue 74, yellow 63, green 98, pink 76, white 64, black 74), each giving one apricorn when ripe and regrowing in about 17 minutes while a player is near (apricorn_facts.regrowth). Red alone is 101 a cycle: 25 copper ingots make 100 Poke Balls, 20,000 at the Mart's 200, against data/markets.json income_basis.cumulative_by_badge 9,475 by the first badge (relayed there from docs/mechanics/PROGRESSION_LADDER.md, not measured here). Thinning is one data edit: fewer tree_x/tree_z, or fewer `A` cells in a design

tree_designs.about: docs/world-building/WORLDGEN_RECOVERY.md section c's seven designs (EXP-019's generated frame: a 5-log trunk, 5x5 corner-cut canopy, 5-8 fruit on the outside of the wide layers, `facing` at the leaf), one per colour. Each layer is a 7x7 grid, rows north to south (z -3..3), columns west to east (x -3..3), from the first block above the floor up: L apricorn log axis y, X log axis x, # leaves (persistent), A fruit (its facing is computed: the first of north, east, south, west holding a leaf in the same layer; a fruit with none fails the build), . nothing.
tree_designs.blue_why: the coastal lean: the trunk steps one block east at the third log (both axis y), the wide layers pushed east, the west side thin
tree_designs.green_why: broad forest: low and wide, ragged edges, the fruit low at the first two layers for easy picking
tree_designs.pink_why: the blossom dome on two branches (axis x logs) at the third layer
tree_designs.white_why: the snow cone: a wide skirt at the second layer, narrowing to a spire
tree_designs.black_why: the gnarled fork: three logs, then two arms on the diagonal, a flat plate with gaps at the fifth layer, patches over each arm

grove_layout.fruit_age: deterministic per fruit column (a hash): age 3 for 5 in 8, else 0, 1 or 2, so a first visit finds ripe fruit and green fruit side by side
grove_layout.why: a 41 by 29 plot, 4 columns of trees 10 apart by 3 rows 9 apart (12 trees), crowns at most 7 wide, so a 3-block walk between crowns and two 2-wide dirt-path alleys between the rows; lantern posts in the alleys between the crowns and in the four inside corners; the gate on the side facing the lane, at the alley end whose outside ground is nearest the terrace floor

groves_why: seven terraces round a central farmyard: three down the west side, three down the east, green at the foot of the avenue. Measured plot relief (tools/ground.py over each 41x29 box, 2026-10-05): red 7, blue 4, yellow 2, green 5, pink 4, white 3, black 4; the east side stands 6-10 higher than the west, so the terraces step up across the farm

paths.why: every path is the top block of its own column swapped for a dirt path (the height never changes); the groves' gate spurs are added by the generator from each gate to its lane

buildings.name: the Hollin farmhouse
buildings.why: the farmer's house, built of its own wood: apricorn planks between stripped apricorn corners, a spruce gable, a cobblestone chimney with a campfire's smoke. Inside, the ball bench (crafting table, grindstone), the larder (smoker, barrels), a table, and the three ball recipes on the north wall, each read from the 1.8.0 jar. No bed (the blackout owns respawn points).

buildings.name: the big barn
buildings.why: the barn the crop goes into: a cobblestone plinth, spruce walls six high, a dark-oak roof running north-south, a wide doorway onto the avenue. Hay along the back wall, barrels and composters, a water trough of cauldrons, a lantern on a post in the middle

sheds_why: open drying sheds: spruce posts, a slab roof, and under it bunches of apricorn leaves hung from the rafters with the fruit on them, two to a bunch, one bunch every two blocks along the middle. The fruit is real: it ripens and can be picked like the groves'. Barrels along the back wall

stall.why: Hollin's farm stall, beside the avenue: corner posts, an apricorn-slab awning, a counter of barrels and apricorn planks on its avenue side, a display branch (leaves and fruit) behind the keeper. The keeper is a CobbleDollars merchant (data/markets.json stall_merchant's entity and shop shape, tools/traders.py summon_line), placed by R18AF

water_tower.why: the farm's water: four spruce-log legs, a plank deck, and a plank tank whose top is water cauldrons (no placed water: a spawn condition). The groves' troughs are water cauldrons too

arch.why: the gate arch over the avenue's north end: two stripped spruce posts, a spruce beam, the farm's name on its north face and a lantern hung under each end

lantern_posts.why: lit as a town (docs/STATE.md 'Places are lit as towns'): posts along the avenue and the lanes about 12 apart, staggered, plus ten in each grove (grove_layout.posts): six in the alleys between the crowns and one in each inside corner, so no floor cell of a grove is more than 14 blocks (Manhattan) from a lantern and none reads block light 0

npc.why: Tamsin Hollin, the farmer, stands on her column's ground + 1 two blocks east of her own door (the door is the farmhouse's east wall at local z -41), off the avenue's three-wide path, facing east across it toward the barn. Placed over RCON by spawnnpcat (tools/reapply.py's "npc" action, step R18AF after R17N), turned to her yaw; the class ships in cobblers_dialogue, compiled from data/dialogue.json

state_model: Every fruit's ripeness lives in its block state (age 0-3) in the world: one tree, one state, shared by every player; first come, first picked, and each fruit regrows on its own while any player keeps the chunk in simulation distance. The farmer's conversation keeps a per-player cursor (quest.ambient_apricorn_farm.farmer_cursor). The stall merchant is one entity with one shop shown to everyone. No scoreboard, no advancement, no per-player gate. Nothing protects the trees: a player can fell one or strip its leaves (which breaks the fruit hung on them); re-running R9AF rebuilds the whole farm
audit_checklist: Write tools/apricorn_farm_audit.py WITHOUT importing tools/apricorn_farm.py to derive anything (CLAUDE.md 'How to prove an audit is independent'): read this file, tools/ground.py, tools/water_mask.py, the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar, the other data files, and the emitted pack and steps only.

Fruit: replay the build; every cobblemon:<colour>_apricorn block has cobblemon:apricorn_leaves at pos.relative(facing) in the FINAL replayed world (canSurvive, apricorn_facts.attachment), age 0-3, and its colour matches its grove (sheds and stall excepted by box). Count fruit per grove; each design's 5-8 per tree.

Terraces: re-derive each grove's floor from the heightmap by ground_rule's own rule (the least-earthwork level that leaves a gate within one block of its outside ground) over its 41x29 box; every interior column's top is the floor block at that y with air above to the canopy; the perimeter wall runs from each column's own ground to the floor where lower; the gate's outside cell's ground is within 1 of the floor (walkable both ways).

Buildings: floor = max ground under the footprint + 1; foundation fills each lower column to it; door cells two blocks of air or door; the NPC's and merchant's feet and head cells are air, standing on a solid block, and not in a path or post cell; the customer cell in front of the counter is reachable from the avenue.

Writes: inside the hold box the steps forceload; nothing on a wet column (tools/water_mask.py and rivers); no block outside blocks.ids; no chest, bed or minecraft:water; the only spawn-condition blocks the seven fruits, and data/spawn_block_policy.json still whitelists them.

Siting from other files alone: every written column at least rules.authored_clearance from every x/z in another data/*.json except data/regions.json, rules.route_clearance from every data/routes.json corridor box (as a filled rectangle) and data/route_paths.json point, rules.town_clearance from every data/towns.json footprint; outside every Rift zone box.
Lighting: no walkable air cell at floor + 1 inside a grove or on a path more than 7 blocks (Manhattan, lantern light 15 to block light 8) from a lantern, or say which cells are dark.

Dialogue and merchant: dlg_apricorn_farmer compiles (tools/compile_dialogue.py --all) with its quest ambient_apricorn_farm; every merchant item id is in the jar; every unit price an integer; R18AF summons the merchant once and kills older copies by tag.

Steps: R9AF holds the farm's box, runs every build function in order, releases, before R9E; R18AF after R17N; cobblers_apricorn_farm in tools/reapply.py's pack list; the prepare job runs the generator.
Mutate the GENERATOR, never this file, to prove each check bites (e.g. flip a fruit's facing in tools/apricorn_farm.py, drop the +1 on a building floor).
